## Identity and scope

Q1486 is Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, distinct from Buenos Aires Province. Provider BUE/AR with AEP and EZE supports the final-city relationship, independent of municipal airport boundaries.

## Claim correspondence and editorial decisions

- All five city-authority visitor pages loaded directly. Plaza de Mayo supports political/civic history; Teatro Colón supports the opera institution and historic building. Removed unconditional interior-visit wording from the attraction; the periodic practical note directs visitors to the current programme.

- Recoleta’s source supports mausoleums, Eva Perón and the neighbouring Basílica Nuestra Señora del Pilar. La Boca cultural guidance directly identifies Caminito as a pedestrian street museum. No old free-tour, opening-hour or ghost-story text imported.

- Recoleta remains the sole base, with La Boca a separate outing. Current Spanish transport guidance describes Subte/bus networks and differing payment options; the product only asks users to check current arrangements.

- SQ replaces literal “histori qytetare”, explains Subte as metro, translates the generic cemetery label, improves Eva Perón inflection and uses lagje rather than mechanically repeated distrikt. Proper names stay recognisable. Four attractions; no all-city sequence.

## Travel preparation

Relationship: direct-city. Provider city group: BUE. Verified airport set: AEP, EZE. Public city and airport datasets inspected at 2026-10-13T22:53:34.334Z; no token or airfare request. A new generic direct-city infrastructure record connects the existing canonical place to provider codes; editorial publication remains independent. Actual selected airport comes from strongest fare evidence, never list order. Targeted restoration and draft-containment verification are documented in the Phase 5E verification report.

## Freshness and human boundary

Owner: GoEksplo editorial maintenance. Stable descriptions retain stable policy; all existing periodic deadlines remain 2027-01-10. Publication timestamps and source consultation dates do not renew those deadlines. No volatile observations, hotel prices, cost calibration, images, runtime research, SEO publication or AI factual calls.

Human review: independently inspect sources, both languages, selection/order, identity and freshness. The evidence-review advisory remains unacknowledged. Source retrieval alone is not factual or editorial approval.
